description_en: Modifies the default certificate for a cloud native mode resource
description_zh: 修改云产品接入的默认证书
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-cloud-resource-default-cert --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-kf740000 --cloud-resource-id lb-000-80-clb7 --cert-id 123-cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCloudResourceDefaultCert

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF during cloud native mode access.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html to connect a resource, and then view the resource ID in the response
parameters.help_zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID
parameters.name: cloud_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
